propositions: The legacy inline last_get_pass field must be removed from bindings.json after a successful new-writer save, with no inline stamps remaining in any entry
Sidecar rotation state must be persisted atomically before inline fields are scrubbed, and the maximum chronological value from both inline and sidecar sources must be preserved in get_rotation.json
When sidecar persistence fails, the primary binding save must succeed with the latest inline value retained as a failure floor, allowing later recovery
A crash between sidecar persistence and bindings replacement must not lose the maximum rotation value, as it is already durable in the sidecar
An old-writer/new-writer sequence that reintroduces a later inline stamp must migrate that maximum into get_rotation.json before scrubbing
